description: This file defines a class for rendering a plus-shaped marker in a graph, extending a base marker class. It includes methods for drawing the plus marker on a canvas, with configurable thickness and size.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Plus
classes.description: A class representing a plus-shaped data marker for graphical plots, with customizable thickness and drawing logic.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the plus marker on the given canvas at specified (x, y) coordinates, using the size and thickness properties.
